Hashes recomputed and equal to manifest.json: task.toml 71f1802d..., workbook 6d44970b..., SKILL.md 8f2b660d..., quality-checks.md 2e1ec096.... (1) Name/slug: task.toml:5 name = "turing/hireops-recruiting-operations"; manifest task path ends in the directory hireops-recruiting-operations, so name equals turing/<dirname> (the snapshot directory named task is excluded by the assignment). Org is turing as the skill delivery profile requires. Slug has 3 hyphen-separated tokens. (2) Description, task.toml:6: each listed axis is in the public brief: tiered approvals and exact valuation (instruction.md:5), netted multi-offer transfers and atomic commit (instruction.md:1), stale previews (instruction.md:3, 9), durable retry receipts incl. restart (instruction.md:3), live multi-member change desk (instruction.md:7, 9). No criterion count is quoted, so nothing to reconcile against the 152/5/5 criterion blocks. (3) Keywords, task.toml:7: recruiting, compensation, ledger (hireops_rules.md:86 'signed ledger adjustment') plus the template's fixed webdev/turing/full-stack. (4) Metadata: difficulty = hard; difficulty_explanation (task.toml:11) matches the brief and rules: restored-balance staleness (instruction.md:3), UTC calendar anniversaries (hireops_rules.md:292), signed adjustments (hireops_rules.md:244), any member removable and 2-4 members (instruction.md:7), what-if for non-saving roles (instruction.md:11), entries surviving reload and ended session (instruction.md:9). category = programming and tags are byte-equal to the template/contract values (template task.toml:13; staged-task-contract.md:48-49). provenance (task.toml:14) and arena_slice = recruiting-hiring-operations (task.toml:15) describe the same HireOps product; app_context.md:3 Name: HireOps, package.json name hireops, index.html title HireOps. No leftover CHANGE_ME placeholder and no reference to another task (search for colderwater across the task returned nothing). Non-blocking observations: (a) the description never writes the product name HireOps (the name field and difficulty/provenance do); (b) the contract's template comment at staged-task-contract.md:42 lists 'judge, dimension policy' as description content, which this description omits, but quality-checks.md ### 8 only requires the product and its actual axes; (c) provenance does not mention the live change-desk extension, though it is not inaccurate. Adversarial reading: a description from a sibling task or stale axes would fail this row; none found. A conforming alternative (no version key) is explicitly allowed and version is indeed absent.
